categories.name: Marvel
categories.description: Explore our Marvel wallpaper collection featuring Iron Man, Thor, Spider-Man, Captain America, Black Panther, and the entire Avengers roster in stunning HD and 4K quality. From cinematic movie stills to minimalist fan art, these wallpapers are optimized for desktop, mobile, and tablet screens. Perfect for fans who want their devices to reflect their favorite superhero universe.

categories.name: DC
categories.description: Discover DC Comics wallpapers starring Batman, Superman, Aquaman, and the Joker in high-resolution HD and 4K formats. This collection spans dark cinematic aesthetics to bold comic-inspired art, giving Gotham and Metropolis fans a wide range of styles to choose from. Every wallpaper is free to download for personal desktop or phone backgrounds.

categories.name: Anime
categories.description: Browse our anime wallpaper collection featuring iconic characters from Jujutsu Kaisen, Demon Slayer, Naruto, Attack on Titan, One Piece, Dragon Ball, and more. These HD and 4K wallpapers capture the bold colors and dynamic energy that make anime art so distinctive. Whether you follow shonen classics or newer series, there's something here for every anime fan.

categories.name: AI Art
categories.description: Explore breathtaking AI-generated artwork spanning serene Japanese landscapes, cosmic space scenes, samurai and warrior sketches, and abstract digital illustration. Each piece is crafted in high resolution for crisp, detailed backgrounds on any screen size. This collection is ideal for fans of calming, atmospheric wallpapers beyond traditional fandom art.

categories.name: Movies & TV Shows
categories.description: Find cinematic wallpapers inspired by iconic movies and television shows, including Breaking Bad, Game of Thrones, American Psycho, Harry Potter, Toy Story, Coco, and Transformers. These HD and 4K wallpapers capture memorable characters and moments in premium quality. A great pick for fans who want their screens to reflect their favorite on-screen stories.

categories.name: Motorsports & Cars
categories.description: Browse high-octane wallpapers featuring Formula 1 legends like Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton, plus supercars and motorcycles from Ferrari, BMW, Porsche, McLaren, and more. This collection includes official race-team liveries and dream-garage supercar shots in crisp 4K detail. Perfect for motorsport fans and car enthusiasts who want desktop-worthy horsepower.

categories.name: Sports
categories.description: Explore wallpapers featuring football legends like Messi, Ronaldo, Neymar, Beckham, and Sergio Ramos in high-resolution HD and 4K quality. This collection spans career-defining moments, iconic celebrations, and clean minimalist portraits of the game's greatest players. A must-browse for football fans building the ultimate sports-themed setup.

categories.name: Gaming
categories.description: Discover wallpapers inspired by iconic video game characters and worlds, including Black Myth: Wukong, God of War's Kratos, Assassin's Creed's Ezio, Call of Duty's Ghost, and GTA. These HD and 4K wallpapers bring cinematic game moments to your desktop or mobile lock screen. Ideal for gamers who want their favorite in-game heroes front and center.
